subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and cancel/steer/resume supervision be modeled as an extension of the existing audit/task/artifact foundations, or as a separate subagent-specific ledger and API?
rationale: The choice fixes a public, security-sensitive persisted event taxonomy, retention/redaction policy, operator authorization boundary, and deterministic control semantics.

options.title: Extend Audit/Task Foundations
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, and artifact lookup surfaces.

options.title: Create Subagent Ledger
options.body: Add a dedicated subagent lifecycle and supervision table/API, accepting the maintenance cost of another durable source of truth.

options.title: Keep Current Summaries
options.body: Decline the durable receipt/control contract for now and document audit.list, task summaries, artifacts, and visibility commands as the supported tools.

recommendation.title: Extend Audit/Task Foundations
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event types over the existing metadata-only audit ledger, task summaries, and artifact lookup surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history across the audit, SQLite state, subagent control, and task lifecycle surfaces involved in the decision.
